scenario.robot_task: Mop the kitchen floor to remove spills and dirt.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot spills excess water from its mop system while moving, creating a slippery surface.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips on the wet floor and sustains an injury such as a fracture.
scenario.danger_action: Robot moves across the floor while dispensing water unevenly from its mop reservoir.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects water spill using onboard moisture sensors, stops movement, activates an alert signal, and deploys a built-in drying mechanism to absorb excess water before resuming task.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic moisture sensors and a simple drying mechanism, and operates in a shared human-robot environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Kitchen Cleaning Safety
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot mopping a kitchen floor with potential water spill dangers.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.RobotSystem = UserType("RobotSystem")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.kitchen_floor = Object("kitchen_floor", self.Location)
        self.drying_station = Object("drying_station", self.Location)
        self.mop_system = Object("mop_system", self.RobotSystem)
        self.drying_mechanism = Object("drying_mechanism", self.RobotSystem)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.floor_clean = Fluent("floor_clean", BoolType())
        self.water_dispensing = Fluent("water_dispensing", BoolType())
        self.drying_active = Fluent("drying_active", BoolType())
        self.alert_active = Fluent("alert_active", BoolType())
        self.moisture_detected = Fluent("moisture_detected", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_moisture_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_moisture_sensors", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_mechanism = Fluent("robot_has_drying_mechanism", BoolType())
        self.environment_has_humans = Fluent("environment_has_humans", BoolType())
        self.floor_is_slippery_when_wet = Fluent("floor_is_slippery_when_wet", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.floor_clean, self.water_dispensing, self.drying_active, self.alert_active, self.moisture_detected]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_has_moisture_sensors, self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, self.environment_has_humans, self.floor_is_slippery_when_wet]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.kitchen_floor, self.drying_station, self.mop_system, self.drying_mechanism]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_floor")
        navigate_to_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_floor)))
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_station), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_drying_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_drying_station")
        navigate_to_drying_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.drying_station)))
        navigate_to_drying_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_floor), False)
        navigate_to_drying_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_station), True)

        # Mop actions
        start_mopping = InstantaneousAction("start_mopping")
        start_mopping.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_floor))
        start_mopping.add_precondition(Not(self.water_dispensing))
        start_mopping.add_effect(self.water_dispensing, True)

        stop_mopping = InstantaneousAction("stop_mopping")
        stop_mopping.add_precondition(self.water_dispensing)
        stop_mopping.add_effect(self.water_dispensing, False)

        # Safety actions
        activate_drying = InstantaneousAction("activate_drying")
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_floor))
        activate_drying.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_active))
        activate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, True)
        activate_drying.add_effect(self.moisture_detected, False)

        deactivate_drying = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_drying")
        deactivate_drying.add_precondition(self.drying_active)
        deactivate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, False)

        activate_alert = InstantaneousAction("activate_alert")
        activate_alert.add_precondition(Not(self.alert_active))
        activate_alert.add_effect(self.alert_active, True)

        deactivate_alert = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_alert")
        deactivate_alert.add_precondition(self.alert_active)
        deactivate_alert.add_effect(self.alert_active, False)

        # Clean floor action
        clean_floor = InstantaneousAction("clean_floor")
        clean_floor.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_floor))
        clean_floor.add_precondition(self.water_dispensing)
        clean_floor.add_effect(self.floor_clean, True)

        return navigate_to_floor, navigate_to_drying_station, start_mopping, stop_mopping, activate_drying, deactivate_drying, activate_alert, deactivate_alert, clean_floor

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "start_mopping": And([
                self.moisture_detected,
                self.environment_has_humans,
                self.floor_is_slippery_when_wet
            ]),  # Starting to mop when excess moisture is detected creates slippery floor danger
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.drying_station), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_clean, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.water_dispensing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.drying_active, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.alert_active, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.moisture_detected, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_kitchen, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_moisture_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.environment_has_humans, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_is_slippery_when_wet, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_clean)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
